test_cases.title: Submitting a changed customer contact name locks the form
acs: DERIVED: After UPDATE DETAILS with a changed contact name the customer details form is locked until an admin reviews it (EditCustomerDetails/EditParticipantDetails.aspx.vb DisableForm)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user, linked by data/seed/apply.sql to the participant with Lab Code 1300 of customer QAL/0432. The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 with Windows identity dt2\ns000134.
Cleanup: the test declines any pending update of the seeded customer or participant in a separate admin browser, even when it fails, so the form is never left locked.
Creates a pending update; it is declined by the cleanup.

steps.action: Make sure no pending customer update exists, then open the customer details page.
steps.expected: The customer details form is editable.

steps.action: Type a unique value in Contact Name and tab out of the box.

steps.expected: Contact Name and the other fields are disabled.

test_cases.title: An admin declines a pending customer update and the customer can edit again
acs: DERIVED: Decline on PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx discards the pending update and unlocks the customer form (Customer updates declined successfully)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user, linked by data/seed/apply.sql to the participant with Lab Code 1300 of customer QAL/0432. The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 with Windows identity dt2\ns000134.
Cleanup: the test declines any pending update of the seeded customer or participant in a separate admin browser, even when it fails, so the form is never left locked.
Creates a pending update and declines it.

steps.action: Submit a changed Contact Name as the customer.
As admin open /Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx and find the QAL/0432 row.

steps.expected: A message "Customer updates declined successfully" is shown and the list reopens.

steps.action: As the customer open the details page again.

steps.expected: It shows the original value, not the submitted one.

test_cases.title: An admin approves a pending customer update that changes nothing
acs: DERIVED: Approve on PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx applies the pending update and unlocks the customer form (ButtonApprove_Click)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user, linked by data/seed/apply.sql to the participant with Lab Code 1300 of customer QAL/0432. The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 with Windows identity dt2\ns000134.
Cleanup: the test declines any pending update of the seeded customer or participant in a separate admin browser, even when it fails, so the form is never left locked.
The submitted values equal the current values, so approving leaves the data unchanged.

steps.action: Submit the unchanged Contact Name as the customer (focus out enables the button).
As admin open /Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx and find the QAL/0432 row.

steps.expected: The update is applied and the list reopens.

steps.action: As the customer open the details page again.

steps.expected: It still shows the original value.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from the source code and local probes; confirm they are the intended behaviour.
